mapper.select: select sdm.ID,sdm.ROOM_ID,sdm.METER_MONTH,room.PARK_ID,sdm.STATEMENT_STATUS from SMT_SD_METERREAD sdm join SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room on sdm.ROOM_ID=room.id where sdm.ID=#{id}

select sd.ID,sd.ROOM_ID,sd.METER_MONTH,sd.STATEMENT_STATUS,sdmd.PRE_MONTH_NUM, sdmd.CUR_MONTH_NUM,sdmd.CATEGORY_ID,sdmd.REV_PRE_MONTH_NUM,sdmd.IS_REVISE,sdmd.TOTAL_STAY_DAYS from SMT_SD_METERREAD sd left join SMT_SD_METERREADDETAIL sdmd on sd.ID=sdmd.MR_ID where sd.ROOM_ID=#{roomId} and METER_MONTH=#{date} order by sdmd.CATEGORY_ID asc

select sdmd.ID,room.ID as ROOM_ID,room.ROOM_NAME,room.FLOOR_ID, sd.METER_MONTH,sd.STATEMENT_STATUS, sdmd.PRE_MONTH_NUM,sdmd.REV_PRE_MONTH_NUM,sdmd.CUR_MONTH_NUM,sdmd.CATEGORY_ID,sdmd.TOTAL_STAY_DAYS from SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room left join SMT_SD_METERREAD sd on room.ID=sd.ROOM_ID and sd.METER_MONTH=#{date} left join SMT_SD_METERREADDETAIL sdmd on sd.ID=sdmd.MR_ID where room.FLOOR_ID=#{floorId} order by room.ID asc
